description:
Check whether names are free on package registries, GitHub, agent and editor directories, app stores, Taiwan trademarks and domains.

Each result has a status:
- available: nobody holds it and the registry would accept it. certainty "confirmed" means every rule
  that public data allows was checked; "probable" means one could not be, and note says which.
- reclaimable: held before but released; it can be taken again.
- taken: someone holds it; url shows who. Where names are not exclusive (MCP Registry, Google Play, Gemini
  CLI gallery, GitHub repositories, trademarks) it means another entry uses the name, and note says it does
  not block a new one.
- unavailable: nobody holds it exactly, but the registry would refuse it (invalid, reserved, too
  similar to an existing name, or blocked for now after a deletion); note says why.
- unknown: no trustworthy answer (network error, rate limit). Never treat it as free.

Pick only the channels that matter for the project instead of checking everything.

channels.description: Channels to check (default: all). One of: npm, pypi, crates, homebrew, rubygems, packagist, pub, nuget, docker, github, github-repo, mcp-registry, smithery, claude-plugins, cursor, gemini, vscode, open-vsx, jetbrains, app-store, google-play, trademark-tw, domain, domain:<tld>. "domain" means every TLD in tlds.

names.description: Candidate names, checked on every selected channel

refresh.description: Download registry name lists again even when the cached copy is fresh

tlds.description: TLDs for "domain", at most 20 (default: com, dev)

name: check_names
title: Check name availability
